name: Direct Root Login Accepted over SSH (Linux)
description: sshd accepted an interactive session for the root account. Most hardened hosts set PermitRootLogin no and require a normal account + sudo, so a successful root SSH login is either a misconfiguration or an attacker using stolen root credentials.
query: event.dataset:"system.auth" and event.outcome:"success" and process.name:"sshd" and (user.name:"root" or system.auth.user:"root") and not source.ip:"127.0.0.1" and not source.ip:"::1"
false_positives: Legacy hosts or appliances that require root SSH (allow-list their management source ranges).
note:
### Triage
- Was this expected for `source.ip`? Confirm with the host owner.
- Review the session's activity and consider disabling PermitRootLogin.
